text:
Priya (CSM): Quick ask — need final uptime/latency comms for Skywell onboarding by EOD tomorrow so Legal can sign. Proposed SLOs: uptime 99.95% monthly, gen p95 <= 220ms. Also need confirmation on credit calc. Who owns the customer-facing one-pager? @Diego @Ava
Diego (Solutions): I can own the one-pager. Will add breakdown for Hosted vs Dedicated and the 'onboarding window' callout. For credits: proposing standard formula, will draft example numbers.
Nate (Eng): Heads-up from runtime: recommend p95 = 250ms for first 30d (cache warmup), then 220ms after tuning. Call that out as "initial onboarding window".
Ava (Onboarding): Agree. Who sends the 30-day health check? I can own the weekly health email with token-level latency, error rate, and cold-start % metrics.
Priya (CSM): Perfect. @OpsBot can you attach the SLA PDF and the reporting template?
OpsBot: Attached: /policies/sla_template_v2.pdf and /reports/monthly_slo_template.xlsx 
Diego (Solutions): Quick SLO table I'll include in the pager:

```
SLO | Target | Measurement window
Uptime | 99.95% | 30d
Gen p95 | <=250ms (0-30d onboarding); <=220ms (31-90d steady) | 30d
Error rate | <0.2% | 30d
```

Priya (CSM): Also surface renewal risk — this account is high-volume during trial. If latency drifts we may hit churn; add an escalation path and a clear credit example for them to understand.
Ava (Onboarding): I'll create a 1-page runbook for their SREs (alerts, contact, quick mitigations) and own the enablement session.
Diego (Solutions): Will include recommended batching/kv-cache hints and a fallback model mapping so they have clear degraded-mode behavior.
Nate (Eng): Add the credit formula to the doc: `credit = max(0, (SLO - observed) / SLO) * multiplier * invoice`. We'll put worked examples (e.g., observed uptime 99.8% => credit = 0.075% * invoice).
Priya (CSM): Timeline: Diego draft by EOD today, I review tomorrow morning, Ava sends first health email 1 week after go-live, Nate verifies metrics feed next Wed. Tagging @Maya for Legal sign-off after draft.
Maya (Legal): I'll review once it's in Drive. Quick Q: does the calc match our standard terms or is it bespoke? If bespoke, I'll need a short justification note.
Priya (CSM): Noted — Diego, please flag if deviating. Tracker link: https://redwood.ai/trackers/SKW-457
Diego (Solutions): Draft uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cXYZ (one-pager + examples).
Ava (Onboarding): Starting slide deck for the enablement session. Will share by Tue.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team — this should cover the customer-facing comms and the internal handoffs. Will follow up after Diego posts the final. :thumbsup:
